selection_rule: APR-1 and CFL4 are retained as training anchors; the two-baseline H_SKYRME group remains in training to keep validation and test curve-balanced. Q_CFL14 is locked to test as the only selected B=100 block. Before fitting any classifier, NumPy default_rng seed 42 selected H_MDI for test and H_HHJ for validation from sorted eligible single-baseline hadronic groups; an independently seeded permutation of eligible B=80 quark groups selected Q_CFL10 for validation.

secondary_quark_block_ood.interpretation: The quark test family uses a B block absent from training; this is a secondary stress test, not an independent analytic-model holdout.

test_use_policy: Do not inspect test labels or metrics until feature representation, shortcut probes, model class, and hyperparameters are frozen from training/validation only.
